# Related papers (53)

English · [简体中文](../zh/related.md) · [Back to the list](../../README.md)

Papers in the collection that fall outside its focus on looped language models: loops in other domains and modalities, puzzle and grid reasoners (Sudoku, maze, ARC) such as HRM and TRM, RNN-, CNN- and GNN-era precursors, implicit models outside language, layer sharing used only to save parameters, and adjacent latent reasoning without loops. They are not ranked and not counted in the design space.

| 2021-02-15 | [On the Theory of Implicit Deep Learning: Global Convergence with Implicit Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.07346)<br><sub>Kenji Kawaguchi · ICLR 2021</sub> | For deep equilibrium models with nonlinearity only on weights, proves that gradient dynamics reach a global optimum at a linear rate without width assumptions, and relates them to trust region Newton on a shallow layer. | [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.07346) | cites 52 |
| 2020-06-15 | [Monotone operator equilibrium networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.08591)<br><sub>Ezra Winston et al. · NeurIPS 2020</sub> | Introduces monDEQ, an implicit-depth model built on monotone operator theory whose parameterization guarantees a unique equilibrium, solved with operator-splitting methods that converge stably; it outperforms Neural ODE-based models while being more computationally efficient. | [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.08591) · [code](https://github.com/locuslab/monotone_op_net) | cites 188 · stars 54 |
